purpose: Creates bucket state. Takes no options and calls useRouter immediately.
state_changes: Creates empty refs for buckets, selection, entries, loading, and error.

purpose: Loads the aggregate table for the current time window.
request_inputs: no body; no headers; no paramsSerializer; params object only. since and until query keys only when the strings are non-empty.
response_use: Maps each row to key lane::preset, numeric risk score, label fallback, numeric series, and 60x20 sparkline paths. Null data becomes [].
state_changes: Replaces bucketsRaw. Does not clear the selected bucket.
error_behavior: Any rejection clears bucketsRaw and does not set a user-visible error. 404, 422, and network failure share that path. No retry.

purpose: Selects one bucket and loads its entries.
request_inputs: no body; no headers; no paramsSerializer; params object only. params lane, preset, and job_hint only when the job-filter argument is non-empty.
response_use: Assigns response data, or [] when data is null.
state_changes: Sets selectedBucket before the request, clears entries and error, sets loading true, then loading false in finally.
error_behavior: console.error and bucketEntriesError = Failed to load bucket entries. Selection is kept. 404, 422, and network failure share that string.

purpose: Clears the open bucket panel.
state_changes: selectedBucket null, entries [], error null, loading false.

purpose: Opens the lab that owns the bucket lane.
request_inputs: Query keys preset (omitted for empty or (none)), lowercased lane, and job_hint when the argument is non-empty. Rosette also sets tab=compare.

purpose: Detail-panel error string.
state_changes: Null at the start of a load.

purpose: Public return of the five export functions. Each function takes its inputs as arguments.
Creates the export functions. No options. The entries argument of downloadBucketJson is unused.
Downloads the currently supplied buckets as a client-built CSV.
request_inputs: buckets, since, until. Empty buckets return before a download.
response_use: Columns lane, preset, count, avg_added, avg_removed, avg_unchanged, risk_score, risk_label. csvEscape. CRLF rows. Blob type text/csv;charset=utf-8;.
side_effects: downloadBlob. Filename crosslab_risk_aggregate plus optional _from- and _to- window plus filenameTimestamp.
error_behavior: No request and no error when buckets is empty.

purpose: Downloads the server CSV for one bucket.
request_inputs: no body; no headers; no paramsSerializer; params object only. params lane, preset, format=csv. responseType blob. Null bucket returns before the request.
response_use: Passes res.data through a new Blob without parsing.
side_effects: downloadBlob filename risk_bucket_<lane>_<preset>.csv. console.error on failure.
error_behavior: Failed to export bucket CSV. No user-visible error.

purpose: Downloads the server JSON blob for one bucket.
request_inputs: no body; no headers; no paramsSerializer; params object only. params lane, preset, format=json. responseType blob. Null bucket returns before the request.
response_use: Passes res.data through a new Blob.
side_effects: downloadBlob filename risk_bucket_<lane>_<preset>.json. console.error on failure.
error_behavior: Failed to export bucket JSON. No user-visible error.

purpose: Downloads a pretty-printed bucket report. The entries argument is not sent.
request_inputs: no body; no headers; no paramsSerializer; params object only. params lane, preset, and job_hint when the job-filter argument is non-empty. responseType json.
response_use: JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) into an application/json blob.
side_effects: downloadBlob filename bucket_report_<lane>_<preset> plus optional _hint- and window plus timestamp. console.error on failure.
error_behavior: console.error only. Does not assign bucketEntriesError.

purpose: Downloads the global risk snapshot.
request_inputs: no body; no headers; no paramsSerializer; params object only. since and until only when non-empty. responseType json.
side_effects: downloadBlob filename risk_snapshot plus window plus timestamp. console.error on failure.
error_behavior: Failed to download global risk snapshot. No user-visible error.
